name: sealed-eval corpus v5
purpose: Private sealed, out-of-sample evaluation of document chat (Aya), built independently of v1-v4 with non-overlapping topics: road-safety statistics and a Safe System slide deck, speech/materials/epidemic-modelling papers with project READMEs, a CLI tool manual, historical farm-sewage bulletins, Hạ Long Bay and water/sanitation Wikipedia articles, and Vietnamese drainage, road-order, culture-statistics, tourism and statistics-organisation legal texts. Questions are authored separately.
build: build_scripts/fetch_all.sh (stages downloads in /private/tmp/aya_v5_stage/{t,w}); then build_scripts/build_corpus.sh raw/ ; then python3 -I build_scripts/make_manifest.py . (writes manifest.json and verifies every file)

pairs.note: Two editions of the NHTSA annual overview. 2022 note (scanned, ARF): 42,514 deaths, 12,151 speeding-related, 13,524 alcohol-impaired. 2023 summary: 40,901 deaths; restates 2022 as final 42,721, speeding 12,157, alcohol-impaired 13,458.
Slide 8 (FHWA) shows US deaths 2014-2023: 2020 = 38,824 and 2023* = 40,990 (preliminary) vs NHTSA 39,007 and 40,901; 2022 = 42,514 matches the 2022 ARF.

Paper plus project README (2021 paper vs 2026 README). README has no CER results or U2 model; cites WeNet 2.0 (not in library). Paper says no Kaldi dependency; README acknowledges borrowing Kaldi code for WFST decoding.

Paper plus README. Paper (Mar 2025) is built on DGL and lists M3GNet, MEGNet, CHGNet, TensorNet, SO3Net; README v3.0.0 (May 2026) removed DGL (PyG only) and lists QET, TensorNet, CHGNet, M3GNet, MEGNet.
Title collision: two files that are both just 'README' (different projects); ambiguous 'the README' questions.

Two Farmers' Bulletins on farm sewage, 1896 vs 1928. Well-distance rules: 100 ft (cesspool, 1896) vs 200 ft (privy pit) and 300 ft (distribution field), 1928. 1896: irrigation best, no septic tanks; 1928: septic tanks.

Same subject in EN and VI Wikipedia. UNESCO criteria vii, viii, ix, x (EN) vs vii, viii (VI); visitor numbers only in VI; VI lead says core zone 335 km2 but a later section says 434 km2 (internal inconsistency).
Decree 88/2007: replaced by NĐ 80/2014 (VI consolidated text) and described in the EN article (10% minimum sanitation surcharge). Decree 88/2007 itself is not in the library.

Number collision: 'Nghị định 85' = 85/2017 (statistics organisation; draft replacement in the comparison table) and 85/2024 (Law on Prices; one of the three amending decrees listed in the consolidated NĐ 80/2014).
Draft circular (native) and its scanned Annex I; Điều 1 says 6 groups / 51 indicators and the annex table has 51 rows in 6 groups (14, 6, 17, 5, 2, 7).
